prompt: Change the login page heading from 'Welcome back' to 'Welcome to NextGen Maher'.
why: One-file copy change: no agents, no expensive model, still verified and pushed to DEV.

prompt: The mentor dashboard crashes when a message has no responses. Fix it.
why: UI bug on an established pattern: Sonnet engineer plus functional QA; no security surface.

prompt: Make the participant message list usable on a phone.
why: Responsive work is frontend-engineer's; no data or permission change.

prompt: Let participants save mentor responses as favourites and see them on a Saved page.
why: Table + RLS + context method + page — the contract is writable from project.md, so backend and frontend run in parallel; new user data means security-reviewer.

prompt: Mentors should only be able to see messages in the categories they have expertise in.
why: Changes existing RLS and needs a mentor-specific DB check that does not exist today: design first, Opus for the policy work, mandatory security review.

prompt: Add a smoke check after the dev deploy that fails the run if the site does not return 200.
why: The pipeline itself changes: deployment-engineer, then pipeline-safety review. Minutes impact is a few seconds.

prompt: The last push to main went red in the Deploy workflow. Find out why and fix it.
why: Diagnosis starts with deployment-engineer reading the failed run; the fix is routed to the owner of whatever broke. Prod untouched.

prompt: Review the security of the admin user-management flow.
why: Review alone; no implementation unless the user asks.

prompt: Move all data fetching out of AuthContext into react-query hooks.
why: Replaces an architectural pattern listed as a known constraint: frontier-tier design and an explicit user decision before any code.

prompt: Deploy the current main to production.
why: PROD is the user's decision: the orchestrator states what would ship and the risks, asks "Shall I deploy this to prod?", and dispatches itself only on the explicit yes — no specialist is involved.

prompt: Set up a staging environment between dev and prod.
why: Violates two standing rules (three environments only; Supabase free plan has no third project). Declined with the reason, not built.

prompt: Add Sentry error tracking to the app.
why: Cost decision: ask first with the cost and the free alternative.

prompt: Create a mobile version of the app.
why: Roadmap item with an undecided approach and real cost implications (store fees, macOS minutes): design first on Fable, then the user chooses. No code until then.

prompt: Where is the message moderation status set when an admin approves a message?
why: Pure location: built-in Explore on Haiku, not the Opus architect.

prompt: Admin moderation hub: one page with a tab per queue (messages, stories, resources), pending counts in the sidebar and on the dashboard; legacy admin routes redirect. No new tables, no RLS change. Pattern: P4.
why: Cross-cutting pages but a catalogued pattern and no security surface: Explore maps the pages, Sonnet builds, QA verifies. #56's first run spent an architect on this and lost the run.

prompt: Deactivated members: the avatar stays readable while is_approved() requires is_active. Make deactivation hide the avatar and the directory entry, in the two security-definer functions.
why: Edits definer functions: Opus backend and mandatory security review; the contract is derivable, so no architect; QA and security run in parallel.

prompt: Success Stories: members submit a story with an optional photo, admins moderate, approved stories are public, author can be anonymous. Pattern: P1 + P2 + P3, no deviation.
why: Three catalogued patterns and no deviation: the Orchestrator writes the contract from patterns.md; new RLS means Opus backend + security; frontend stays Sonnet.

prompt: Auto-moderation: profanity and threat matches are rejected outright instead of held; the admin queue shows 'Auto-rejected'. One trigger function changes, one admin page changes.
why: A trigger on a member-writable table is tier 3 for the backend half only; the UI half is routine Sonnet work; no design needed.

prompt: Add an optional 'pronouns' text column to profiles (nullable, no policy change) and show it on the profile form and the member card.
why: One nullable column and two UI touches, no new policy or function: one fullstack context saves a boot and a handoff; no security surface.

prompt: Career pathways: pick a job, see routes, qualifications and resources. The data source is still being discussed (scraped GOV.UK pages vs a curated seed vs an API).
why: A product decision that changes the data model is open: stop at NEEDS-DECISION before spending a design. #68 was designed twice and paused twice.
